reasoning_details.text:
I'm noting how the critique calls out filler backstory in the "Problem" and "Project Tasks" sections of these case-study templates—irrelevant history that adds nothing. Response A keeps the ironic, listing style going with another "classic" example, continuing to poke at vague, unsupported claims in the template.

Response B misreads the task entirely, treating it like actual project chaos and giving advice about resolving contradictions with a client rather than critiquing the writing itself—it drifts off-topic and has a typo. A is clearly the stronger response here.
